summary: Iteration 6 re-verification of Cook Mode after hoisting CookMode to Favorites page level and closing the Radix Dialog on launch. Verified BOTH entry points (Home + Favorites) using REAL page.mouse.click at button-center coordinates. All Cook Mode interactions work: cook-mode-button opens full-screen cook-mode via portal (data-testid=cook-mode), progress 'Passo X di Y' updates correctly, next/prev advance and go back without dismissing the overlay, cook-mode-finish appears on the last step and closes the overlay, cook-mode-close (X) and Escape both close it. From Favorites, closing cook-mode returns to an intact favorites list. Step timer renders on steps mentioning minutes (e.g. '8 minuti') and counts down after step-timer-toggle.
critical_code_review_comments: CookMode is now correctly portalled to document.body (z-[60]) and Favorites closes the Radix Dialog (setSelected(null)) before launching Cook Mode - previous overlay interception bug fully resolved.
RecipeCard uses onCookMode prop when provided (Favorites path) and falls back to internal state (Home path) - clean separation.

Minor: window keydown listener in CookMode is attached whenever component mounts; the early-return `if (!open || !recipe) return null` occurs after hook registration which is fine, but the listener could be guarded with an early return inside handler (already done via `if (!open) return`).
seed_data_creation: Seeded a single favorite recipe via localStorage key 'zsc_favorites' with 3 brigade steps (step 2 contains '8 minuti' to exercise the timer). Cleaned up implicitly on next test run.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Cook Mode overlay bug from iteration 5 is fully fixed. Both entry points verified with real mouse clicks. Substitutions rendering depends on AI output; not present in this run's generated recipe (no matching shopping_list/substitutions entries) but code path is intact and previously verified. To re-test substitutions, seed a favorite that has matching shopping_list + substitutions arrays.
